description.value: Pak Tak Chiu Chow Restaurant has been serving authentic Chiu Chow and Cantonese homestyle cuisine from inside Yaohan Centre in Richmond since 2000. The restaurant is particularly known for its Soy Sauce Duck, Cold Crab, and Braised Pork Belly with Preserved Vegetables. Its mall location gives cycling visitors access to a full food court environment with takeout and catering options.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 28m; rack at 37m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at yaohanpaktak.com is live and describes a functioning restaurant at Yaohan Centre, #1050-3700 No. 3 Road, Richmond BC, operating since 2000. The website explicitly confirms takeout service ('options for take out or delivery service'). No evidence exists on the website for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities; OSM tags also provide no such data.
concerns: OSM name is 'Pak Tak' but website consistently uses 'Pak Tak Chiu Chow Restaurant' as the full name.
OSM had no phone or address; both were obtained from website only so contact_confirmed fields cannot compare against OSM values.
Website copyright dated 2015 — site appears static/aging, but content and contact details show no signs of closure.
URL discovery confidence was 'medium'; website content does corroborate the business name and location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant inside Yaohan Centre in Richmond with an active website and confirmed takeout service. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking authentic Chinese food.
enrichment_extras.notes: A second phone number is listed on the website: 604-809-8102. Business is located indoors in Yaohan Centre (confirmed by OSM tags indoor=room, level=0 and website text).

wow_evidence: serving authentic Chiu Chow and Cantonese homestyle cuisine... since 2000
